actions.action: Gently pull the plant up to check whether roots are anchored in the bark
Insert a stake along the root ball and tie the plant loosely to it
Place the clear pot inside a heavier ceramic cachepot
Add pebbles or stones under the pot for ballast
Gently firm the bark around the roots
Water when the bark is dry
Keep the plant out of drafts

reason: The answer correctly identifies a top-heavy, unstable pot as the main cause, and its second fix, setting the pot inside a heavier cachepot, matches what the poster did, with nothing harmful suggested.
